purpose: Independent classical-MD check (MEAM) of the GB10's MACE melting point and latent heat.
status: inputs only; NOT submitted. Ask Madhan before submitting any Nebius job.
engine: LAMMPS (needs the MEAM package: check `lmp -h | grep -i meam` on the Nebius image)

potential.citation: E.C. Do, Y.-H. Shin, and B.-J. Lee (2008), "A modified embedded-atom method interatomic potential for indium", Calphad 32(1), 82-88.

structure.source: coolorbit/sim/alloys.py ELEMENT_CRYSTALS (Donohue, The Structures of the Elements, 1974; alpha-Ga: Sharma & Donohue 1962). Starting lattice constants; NPT relaxes them.

melting_point_guess.source: data/calibration/tier1.json (Assael et al., J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 41, 033101 (2012), doi:10.1063/1.4729873, Table 2, citing ITS-90)
melting_point_guess.use: ONLY to place the temperature bracket. Not a reference value: the calibration references live in data/calibration/ (Teammate 1).

jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_In-coexist-T343.8.lammps -var T 343.8 -var Tprep 429.7 -var Tmelt 1289.1 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_In-coexist-T386.8.lammps -var T 386.8 -var Tprep 429.7 -var Tmelt 1289.1 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_In-coexist-T429.7.lammps -var T 429.7 -var Tprep 429.7 -var Tmelt 1289.1 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_In-coexist-T472.7.lammps -var T 472.7 -var Tprep 429.7 -var Tmelt 1289.1 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_In-coexist-T515.7.lammps -var T 515.7 -var Tprep 429.7 -var Tmelt 1289.1 -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_In-latent-solid.lammps -var phase solid -var T <Tm_MEAM> -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_In-latent-liquid.lammps -var phase liquid -var T <Tm_MEAM> -var seed 2026

latent.protocol: solid vs liquid enthalpy at Tm

analysis.latent: python ../analyze.py latent h_solid_T<Tm_MEAM>.dat h_liquid_T<Tm_MEAM>.dat --log-solid log_In-latent-solid.lammps --log-liquid log_In-latent-liquid.lammps

if_bracket_missed: all melting -> shift the bracket down by 20%; all freezing -> up by 20% (same rule as the GB10 Simulator), then refine around the crossover with 4 temperatures 2% apart.
